comments: 70f4c8d9: This routine handles the summarization and checking of discharge summaries within the VistA system.
d9a54d1b: Main entry point for checking the validity and completeness of a discharge summary for a given patient.
e80b5266: Initialize a local variable for output.
aee77029: Retrieve division parameters; if not set, defaults will be used.
7d4752d2: Exit if division parameters are not defined.
e0cd6ac8: Set the default document type to 'DISCHARGE SUMMARY' if not provided.
33897e25: If a record already exists and lacks a completion date, flag it for update.
5446a70f: Exit if the interim record already exists and is valid.
7b552386: Iterate through patient's discharge summaries to find a match.
993c1182: Set flag if a matching record is found.
79eea9f6: If no matching record is found, proceed to add a new entry.
4fd1a771: End of the CHECK subroutine.
f53d4995: Subroutine to add a new discharge summary entry.
9d79c912: Initialize variables for adding a new record.
cb8b184a: Determine service related to the ward where the patient stayed.
48147690: Set service variable, defaulting to 0 if not found.
cd564392: Retrieve the patient's movement record for the admission.
93254169: Set documentation variables based on division parameters.
dd8aac1d: Additional documentation setup based on division parameter for signed discharge summaries.
35b53276: Set event date and ward for the new record.
56cb13c3: Create a new entry in the discharge summary file.
87a7e99c: Exit if the new record creation failed.
f941e208: Attempt to lock the new record for editing.
561b49a0: Update the newly created record with specific details.
872c1bc2: Finalize editing of the new record.
2dcf4627: Release the lock on the new record.
ea0f9b67: Set flag indicating a new record has been added.
471fca2e: Subroutine to edit an existing discharge summary.
8f6c290b: Attempt to lock the record for editing.
4509d56f: Set specific fields for the discharge summary.
98e6fbb5: Finalize the edits and update the status.
f6de194c: Release the lock on the edited record.
665ab386: End of the EDIT subroutine.
36aaa27d: Subroutine to delete specific fields from a discharge summary.
a75cd078: Attempt to lock the record for deletion process.
ebc89854: Clear specified fields from the discharge summary.
0f8d0bb3: Finalize the deletion process and update the status.
947cf24a: Release the lock on the record after deletion.
5b79313f: End of the DCSDEL subroutine.
d226777b: Subroutine for signing and updating discharge summary fields.
d5e9397a: Attempt to lock the record for signing.
e214345a: Set sign-off fields in the discharge summary.
b69017fc: Finalize the sign-off process and update the status.
334566d6: Release the lock on the signed record.
3733bbe6: End of the SIGUP subroutine.
3f8e1d4f: Subroutine to update the status of a discharge summary.
2f3784a3: Initialize variables for status update.
7450ebc8: Retrieve the current status node for the discharge summary.
1d2a3221: Set status to 'INCOMPLETE' if no completion date.
d443207a: Set status to 'DICTATED' if no dictation date.
75942ac9: Set status to 'TRANSCRIBED' if no transcription date.
dac04369: Set status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' if review is not required.
ff7f009a: Set status to 'SIGNED' if signed.
08ce7333: Set status to 'REVIEWED' if review is required and completed.
8d04382e: Update the record with the new status.
59b8510d: End of the STAT1 subroutine.
a23c4e9a: Subroutine for handling document codes based on parameters.
78260e0d: Retrieve division parameter for the document code.
cf98c30b: Set document code based on admission service and parameter settings.
f38c122e: End of the DOC subroutine.
